verdict.rationale: Loops is an email platform for software companies, not an agent or AI client, so plugging MCP servers into it to consume their tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows Loops only in the opposite role: it publishes its own MCP server for external agents to connect to. That server-side evidence does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing shows Loops has a built-in agent that could act as an MCP client.
